title: [Refurbished] BLUETTI AC180 Portable Power Station 1,800W 1,152Wh $539.00 Delivered @ Bluetti AU
body:
Deal: [Refurbished] BLUETTI AC180 Portable Power Station 1,800W 1,152Wh $539.00 Delivered @ Bluetti AU

[AsukaST] It's just so wrong and so misleading to compare the price of a refurbished product with a new product and say it's
"Was $1299, 59% off".
This rep should be banned.
[exc3113nce] Can’t compare pricing of a refurbished product against a new product. It’s misleading and against the law.
[twocsies] I believe you are completely incorrect. As long as a business clearly indicates that a product is refurbished, it can also provide a price comparison with the price of a new product.
[AsukaST] All I see is, "(originally $1,299 new)"
That's because mod has removed the misleading texts after I reported it.
https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/980590/revisions#2153041vs…
[shoppe] Okay my bad.
I didn't see that it was changed.
[kizzaaa] 1,152Wh capacity
Battery Health: Guaranteed 90%+ battery capacity compared to new units.
So the actual capacity is likely closer 1,037Wh.
What is the warranty for refurbs? Is it still 5 years?
[merriweather] Says 5 years on the linked page, presumably still applies
[aleayr] This post isn't Anker, but what happened with Anker last time?
[caitsith01] They put an obviously erroneous price up, cancelled a bunch of orders with some sort of discount back to people, and a bunch of crybabies lost their minds about not getting a $1k product for $200.
[Watchdogathon] then had the audacity to place us all on mailing lists…
[battler] Question mark over why there are 60 units available for refurb. Returns? What's the fault rate of new ones?
